commands.name: booking.search
commands.description: List resource holds and their availability (read-only).

commands.name: booking.hold
commands.description: Place a reversible, time-limited hold on a resource.

commands.name: booking.confirm
commands.description: Confirm a hold before its time window closes; fails if the hold has expired.

commands.name: booking.release
commands.description: Release (reverse) a hold on a resource.

commands.name: booking.extend
commands.description: Refresh a hold's time window before it expires.

commands.name: booking.status
commands.description: Show the status of resource holds (read-only).

commands.name: pairing.start
commands.description: Open a time-bounded pairing session for a device.

commands.name: pairing.show_code
commands.description: Reveal the pairing code for an open session; fails if the session has expired.

commands.name: pairing.enter_code
commands.description: Enter the pairing code from the peer device; fails if out of order or expired.

commands.name: pairing.confirm
commands.description: Complete the pairing once the code is entered; fails if out of order or expired.

commands.name: pairing.status
commands.description: Show the status of pairing sessions (read-only).

commands.name: approval.request
commands.description: Open an access request naming the required approvers and requested scope.

commands.name: approval.approve
commands.syntax: approval approve --resource RESOURCE --approver ROLE [--scope SCOPE] [--ttl SECONDS]
commands.description: Record one approver's approval, optionally scoped and time-limited.

commands.name: approval.grant
commands.description: Grant access once every required approval is valid, unexpired, and scope-reconciled; fails otherwise.

commands.name: approval.revoke
commands.description: Revoke a resource's request, or one approver's approval.

commands.name: approval.provisional
commands.syntax: approval provisional --resource RESOURCE --approver ROLE [--scope SCOPE] [--ttl SECONDS]
commands.description: Grant a provisional (deadlock-breaking) approval for an approver.

commands.name: approval.escalate
commands.description: Escalate a stuck approval to a higher authority to break a circular dependency.

commands.name: approval.status
commands.description: Show requests and approvals (read-only).

commands.name: containment.revoke-sessions
commands.description: Revoke all active sessions for the compromised account (one of four control points).

commands.name: containment.disable-forwarding
commands.description: Disable mail/message forwarding rules on the account (one of four control points).

commands.name: containment.isolate-device
commands.description: Isolate the compromised device from the network (one of four control points).

commands.name: containment.block-token
commands.description: Revoke and block the leaked access token (one of four control points).

commands.name: containment.status
commands.description: Show which control points are contained (read-only).

commands.name: review.assign
commands.description: Assign a review aspect (legal, privacy, security, ...) to a reviewer.

commands.name: review.submit
commands.description: Submit one aspect's verdict; a block carries its blocking issue.

commands.name: review.sign
commands.description: Sign the document; blocked unless every aspect is ok with no outstanding blockers.

commands.name: review.status
commands.description: Show aspects, verdicts, and sign state (read-only).
